title: ErrorResponse
description: The body of every failed call. The HTTP status says how the transport failed; `error.code` says what the core refused and is what a caller branches on.

CoreErrorCode.description: What went wrong, as a closed set. `invalid_request` is a payload the core would not accept, `not_found` an identifier that resolves to nothing, `rate_limited` a caller asked to wait, `internal` a fault the core does not explain further, and `generation_failed` a job that started and could not finish — the only code that never appears as an HTTP response, because by then the call has already been answered.

CoreError.description: One failure, as the core reports it.

message.description: English, for a log and an audit record. Never rendered to a user: what a user reads is chosen by the caller from `code`.
